message.content: Closures get changed all the time—sometimes even while drones are already flying. For example, an area might get widened, or an end time for a closure might move. The authorities send updates, and we have to adjust our flights right away. Sometimes a closure gets lifted early, or a new one pops up suddenly, like if there’s an emergency. We have to watch for those changes and make sure our flights stay safe. It’s a lot of back-and-forth.
